title: Alleviating Hallucination in Reasoning Tasks with Training-Free Uncertainty-Guided Steering
abstract: arXiv:2609.38962v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent work on hallucination detection in large language models has shown that, for a fixed pre-trained model and reasoning task, it is possible to estimate the model's confidence in the correctness of its outputs. Such uncertainty estimates have primarily been used to improve truthfulness by detecting or filtering confabulations. In this work, we ask whether these signals can instead be used more proactively to directly improve the accuracy of model-generated answers. We propose USteer, a simple, training-free steering mechanism that adjusts a model's layer-wise activations during inference using the gradient of a confidence measure with respect to the activations. This procedure nudges generation toward outputs with lower uncertainty at inference time, without modifying model parameters or requiring additional supervision. translated_title: 基于无需训练的不确定性引导转向方法缓解推理任务中的幻觉
translated_abstract: 关于大语言模型中幻觉检测的最新研究表明，对于固定的预训练模型和推理任务，可以估计模型对其输出正确性的置信度。这类不确定性估计此前主要用于通过检测或过滤虚构内容来提升真实性。在本工作中，我们探讨这些信号能否更主动地用于直接提升模型生成答案的准确性。我们提出了USteer，一种简单的、无需训练的转向机制，它利用置信度度量相对于激活值的梯度，在推理过程中调整模型各层的激活。该过程在推理时将生成引导向不确定性更低的输出，而无需修改模型参数或额外的监督。我们证明，该方法在一系列任务中持续减少幻觉，表明置信度信号不仅可以用于检测错误，还能直接提升答案的准确性。
tldr: 提出USteer，一种无需训练的推理时激活引导方法，通过置信度梯度将模型生成导向低不确定性输出，在不修改模型参数、无需额外监督的情况下有效缓解推理任务中的幻觉。
en_tdlr: USteer is a training-free inference-time steering mechanism that uses the gradient of a confidence measure to guide model activations toward lower-uncertainty outputs, consistently reducing hallucination without modifying model parameters or requiring additional supervision.
